messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled release window in 60m for services: api, runtime, console, router.

deploy-bot: Manifest pinned: api@v4.2.1, runtime@r1.9.0-quant, console@c3.0.0-feature-flag, router@rtr-2026-07. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% (30m) -> 100% (1h). Rollback criteria: >2% overall 5xx or p95 latency +30s baseline.

marie: Quick checks — no DB migrations, no schema changes. Release notes: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-07-rc1 :eyes:

raj: Runtime note: we've disabled kernel-switch autotune for this rollout (flag: runtime.kernel_autotune=false).
KV cache: will force-evict prefix cache on canary nodes to avoid stale prefixes.
Quantization: using int8-ctx config; watch tokenization discrepancy on eval.

sam: Router: will route canary traffic via route "/inference/v1/canary" weight 5% then 25%.
Sticky sessions: still enabled by session_id cookie, no change.
If rollbacks needed, we'll flip weight back to 0 then drain.

kait: Console: feature gate "show-new-model" will be OFF for canary by default. We'll enable for 25% only if metrics look good.
UI note: telemetry patch pushed to staging already.

olivia: API contract stable. Client header version must be pinned to "X-RW-Client: 4.2.1" for compatibility.
Patch example:
```
PATCH /v1/models/pin
{ "model": "api@v4.2.1" }
```

lina: Oncall will watch.
Alerts: set temporary alert: api_5xx_rate > 0.02 over 5m; runtime_p95 > baseline+30s over 5m.
I'll post heartbeat checks to #incidents.

marie: Final: thumbs? Say "proceed" to start canary.

raj: proceed
sam: proceed
kait: proceed
olivia: proceed
lina: proceed

marie: @deploy-bot please start canary with manifest https://artifacts.internal/releases/2026-07/manifest.yaml --canary=5 --staged-steps="5,25,100" --checks=auto

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Starting canary -> 5% across router shard-a first. Logs: https://deploys/internal/1769999990

deploy-bot: Canary step 1/3 complete: 5% routed, healthchecks good. Monitoring windows open 30m.

lina: watching. will call abort if thresholds breach. :phone:

marie: thanks everyone — we'll iterate if anything looks off. :thumbsup:
